name: crispe-coach-plugin
description: Converts rough descriptions or ideas into well-structured prompts using the CRISPE framework (Context, Role, Instruction, Specification, Performance, Example). Coaches patiently -- asks one focused question when a component is missing rather than guessing -- and embeds the same patient, ask-don't-guess behavior into every generated prompt. Offers to execute the prompt immediately after presenting it. Also triggers on Chinese equivalents: '转成CRISPE格式', '用CRISPE框架改写', '优化这个提示词'.
